body:
## Pull request overview Adds nominative SSH access support by introducing `localpart:*@` handling in policy/v2 SSH rules, aligning headscale’s compiled SSH policy output more closely with Tailscale SaaS behavior and expanding the SSH-policy compatibility test coverage. **Changes:** - Add `SSHUser` helpers to detect/parse `localpart:*@` and update SSH policy validation accordingly. - Update SSH policy compilation to emit per-user `tailcfg.SSHRule` entries (and handle `autogroup:self` filtering, `user:*@domain` sources, and `acceptEnv` passthrough). - Add/extend unit + integration + data-driven compatibility tests and captured SSH expected-results fixtures. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 48 out of 48 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | integration/ssh_test.go | Adds helpers to SSH as an arbitrary user and introduces an OIDC-based integration test for `localpart` behavior. | | hscontrol/policy/v2/types.go | Introduces `localpart` parsing/validation, `user:*@domain` alias support, and adds `acceptEnv` to SSH rules. | | hscontrol/policy/v2/types_test.go | Adds policy unmarshal tests and unit tests covering `localpart` parsing and `SSHUsers` helpers. | | hscontrol/policy/v2/filter.go | Updates SSH policy compilation to generate per-user rules for `localpart` and handle new SSH rule fields/ordering. | | hscontrol/policy/v2/filter_test.go | Updates/extends compilation tests to reflect new rule shapes (root deny defaults, localpart interleaving, principals grouping). | | hscontrol/policy/v2/tailscale_ssh_data_compat_test.go | Adds a data-driven test runner for captured Tailscale SSH policy outputs. | | hscontrol/policy/v2/testdata/ssh_results/*.json | Adds captured expected SSH policy outputs (fixtures) used by the data-driven compat tests. | | hscontrol/policy/policy_test.go | Extends policy tests to cover `localpart` mapping behavior in the legacy policy test suite. | | CHANGELOG.md | Documents breaking/behavior changes around SSH compilation semantics. | | .github/workflows/test-integration.yaml | Ensures the new `TestSSHLocalpart` integration test is executed in CI. |
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1) **hscontrol/policy/v2/filter.go:370** * `compileSSHPolicy` no longer has a `//nolint:gocyclo` suppression even though this repo enables `gocyclo` via golangci-lint. Given the function's size/branching, this is likely to trip the cyclomatic-complexity check and fail CI. Either refactor to reduce complexity below the linter threshold, or re-add a scoped `//nolint:gocyclo` with a brief justification (consistent with other complex functions in the codebase). ``` func (pol *Policy) compileSSHPolicy( baseURL string, users types.Users, node types.NodeView, nodes views.Slice[types.NodeView], ) (*tailcfg.SSHPolicy, error) { ```
